split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before public reporting source family, schema anchor, workflow action, generated report, tmp artifact, badge, scorecard, release-evidence bundle, public status, or public claim language
split_policy.positive_rule: public conformance reporting rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners in upstream checked-in evidence families; public reports, schemas, scorecards, badges, tmp artifacts, workflow labels, generated summaries, and provenance rows are never positive behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: dashboard schemas, scorecard schemas, generated summaries, tmp reports, tmp artifacts, badges, release-evidence bundles, workflow actions, public summaries, public status labels, and claim-language rows are provenance or routing until a behavior owner claims the underlying behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: evidence-log support, generated-only support, generated-evidence-log support, dashboard-only support, scorecard-only support, badge-only support, tmp-artifact-only support, workflow-label-only support, provisional-as-claim-ready promotion, blocked/quarantined evidence promotion, compatibility, gate, retired route, old-mode, and unsupported public claim language are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: parser/sema/lowering/IR/runtime/e2e behavior, upstream conformance evidence, external validation evidence, schemas, release-evidence bundles, workflow actions, scorecards, badges, tmp artifacts, generated summaries, dashboard statuses, and public claim language are distinct evidence classes; only upstream behavior owners may promote behavior support
